source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Exodus 28–31.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves inclusive Aaron-and-sons sash clause, head coverings, permanent priesthood and repeated fill-hands idiom.
Preserves organ/fat list and smoke-offering verb; liver appendage rendered lobe with anatomical uncertainty noted.
Keeps three discarded components, outside location and sin-offering category, distinguishing disposal burning from altar smoke.
Retains complete ram, offering category, sensory aroma and repeated divine recipient.
Preserves precise right-sided ear/hand/foot application for all named priests and remaining altar action; does not invent symbolism.
Keeps full list including fat tail and right thigh, with ordination rationale retained.
Retains literal hands filled by portions and tenufah presentation, with uncertainty about exact motion noted.
Keeps breast/waving and thigh/contribution distinction without collapsing the two technical terms.
Preserves atonement-linked meal and holy-food restriction; outsider means outside authorized priestly group, not necessarily foreign nationality.
Keeps daily bull, altar purification and anointing; does not assign moral wrongdoing to an inanimate altar.
Keeps seven days and contact holiness as result with must-be-holy alternative noted, not a vague cleanliness rule.
Makes Hebrew plural meeting and singular speech addressee explicit while retaining enduring recurring offering and location.
Supplies place as understood subject of consecrated while retaining divine glory as sanctifying agent; subject openness noted.
